gh pr create --base main --title "APRV-408: doctor harness-hook-wiring derives its roster from the Claude adapter and binds the handler --dir" --body "## APRV-408

**What was wrong.** \`harness-hook-wiring\` compared the PreToolUse matcher against a hand list of three tools (\`Edit, Write, Bash\`) while the Claude adapter gates five. A matcher of \`Bash|Edit|Write\` passed doctor with \`MultiEdit\` and \`NotebookEdit\` writes reaching protected paths unclassified. The handler was recognised by the substring \`approval hook\`, so a wrapper, another harness's entry, or a \`--dir\` naming a checkout that does not exist on this machine all read as wired.

**What changes.**
- The gated roster is read from \`HARNESS_ADAPTERS[\"claude-code\"]\`; the hand list is deleted.
- The handler command is parsed (executable basename \`approval\`, verb \`hook claude-code\`, \`--dir\`), and \`--dir\` is compared with this checkout's primary root. A different checkout is the row's one **fail**; a wrapper, substitution, relative path or missing value is a skip that says unresolved and is never a pass.
- A matcher that is not a plain \`|\`-joined tool list is reported as resolving no coverage; the pattern is never compiled, so a hostile one cannot hang doctor.
- The adapter read tools the matcher leaves out (\`Read, Glob, Grep\`) get one informational line naming them as the documented default. It never fails the row and the committed matcher is unchanged.
- A matched tool the adapter does not handle is named as the \`is not a gated tool\` allow it receives.
- \`harness-hook-outcomes\` shares the same reading of which entries are ours.

**Origin.** A ChatGPT capability-inventory proposal (57 KB, new verb, MCP snapshot import, log projection). Its one durable finding was this drift; the rest is deferred with no task filed.

**Verification.** \`npm run build\`, \`typecheck\`, \`lint\` exit 0. \`node scripts/run-tests.mjs --only cli-doctor cli-hook harness-enum cli-doctor-wiring docs-guard cli-doctor-codex cli-help\`: 279 pass, 0 fail. New \`tests/cli-doctor-wiring.test.ts\`: nine cases, each on a real \`git init\` checkout. Built CLI run from this linked worktree: wiring **pass**, bound to \`/Users/carter/dev/approval-md\`, read-tools line present, no passthrough line; outcomes pass unchanged.

SPEC §11 touched (self-reported fields never reduce scrutiny; fail closed): stated in the task's implementation notes.
